name: Lerp written into the input tensor
plain: Plain lerp, but written with torch.lerp(out=a["samples"]) after a shallow dict copy, so the tensor owned by the upstream node is overwritten. That can corrupt ComfyUI's cached output of the upstream node when another branch reads it.
math: a.samples ← a + t(b − a), in place
